# eDB

> llms.txt for the eDB repository (embeddedos-org/eDB).
> Status: the EmbeddedOS embedded database — a small
> SQL/document store for constrained devices, with a service
> API (FastAPI) and a natural-language query translator.

eDB is the data layer of the EmbeddedOS ecosystem: an embedded
database engine sized for MCU-class targets, exposed to apps
through its API and CLI.


## Docs

- [Getting Started with eDB](docs/getting-started.md)
- [eDB Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [eDB API Reference](docs/api-reference.md)
